start: 60% core + cap already invested; remaining cash. Benchmark identical initial holdings.
rules: At upper quarter sell one 5%-budget lot; downside failure also sells. Rebuy identical grams only after 15/20/25 CNY/g drop and return to lower half of base zone. No shorting. Later-observation execution.
limitations: Same overlapping 13 exploratory episodes; current-vintage synthetic CNY quotes; no China holiday calendar; subjective forecasts static and hindsight contaminated. Not executable historical bank returns.
selection: All 72 combinations retained; no final strategy selected; unrecovered gold valued as opportunity cost at terminal bid.
